entries.target: A long range attack that deals damage to 1 target.

entries.target: A long range attack that deals damage to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: Magically enhance your sword with powerful auras, dealing unavoidable critical damage to your foe and calling upon the power of light applying Resplendent Aura, a Heal Over Time for 10 seconds that grows stronger as you auto attack more, up to 5 times. If Invictus is active, you instead call upon the power of the shadow and apply Destructive Aura on each auto attack, increasing your damage output by 20% for each strike, up to 5, lasting 10 seconds.
notes: Applies Resplendent Aura for 90 seconds if Invictus is NOT active.
Applies Destructive Aura for 90 seconds if Invictus IS active.

entries.officialDescription: With enough force, you strike your target hard enough to cause the aura currently strengthening your weapon to resonate with the opposite effect. notes: Applies Omni Resplendent to caster for 10 seconds if Resplendent Aura is in play, increasing all outgoing damage by 30%.
Applies Omni Destructive to caster for 10 seconds if Destructive Aura is in play, reducing caster's damage taken by 30%.
